name: Process Run Scan
description: One captured component identity — the genealogy row. This is what makes 'which packs contain module batch X' answerable in a single query, turning a field failure from 'quarantine the fleet' into 'quarantine nine packs'. The raw payload is always kept, even when no pattern matched.

fields.label: Position
fields.description: Which one of the expected count this is — module 1, 2 or 3.

fields.label: Batch Reference
fields.description: Batch-level containment: one extra field buys what 48 per-cell scans would.

fields.label: Raw Payload
fields.description: Stored verbatim regardless of whether a pattern matched.

fields.label: Manual Entry
fields.description: Typed rather than scanned. Always permitted — a scan is never mandatory.

fields.label: Parse Failed
fields.description: No configured pattern matched. Add one on the entity type and re-parse; the payload was not lost.

fields.label: Duplicate Of
fields.description: A run that already recorded this serial. Recorded per the entity type's duplicate policy.

fields.label: Client UUID
fields.description: Set by the app when the row was created on the handset. The dedup key for offline sync: a batch replayed after a lost response resolves to the same row rather than appending a twin.
